test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.**

A form of government in which the supreme power is vested in the people and exercised by their elected agents under a free electoral system.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Democracy means a system in which the government of a country is elected by the people. (लोकतांत्र)

 
 
• Example- "Dictatorship was repudiated, and democracy accepted as a system of values."
 
 

 
• India is a democratic country.
 
• In a Democracy, the people of a country elect the people who run the country.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1' which is '*Democracy*'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Anarchy means a situation in which people do not obey rules and laws; a situation in which there is no government in a country

 (शासनहीनता की स्थिति; अराजकता)
 
• Monarchy means a political system based upon the undivided sovereignty or rule of a single person. (साम्राज्य)
 
• Autocracy is government or control by one person who has complete power. (एकतंत्र).

225:T8d4,

The correct answer is '**Option 2**'
